a09a42d5be630931.short: Flooding scrapped the confirmed ground-floor room and left the hallway smelly. Kids loved the waterpark, but the crowded resort wasn't his kind of place.

f1e6060dea1ad0e6.short: Suite ready at 9am, red wine waiting. The club breakfast was the most lackluster seen at a Hyatt in Asia, mostly continental and omelets.

f71eeeb25601b239.short: Upgraded before arrival, with a reminder not to expect it every time. Park Hyatt-level service, and would return without hesitation.

1e4ee0adb602ea2c.short: Arrived over an hour early and were offered changing rooms for the pools while the suite was readied. Free parking and $20 casino credit.

4f4ef95f3d5e766e.short: Breakfast across three restaurants was deeply confusing: the menu listed à la carte, then only eggs could be ordered. Back only at the right price.

18e5992c7e86cbdb.short: No waiting after arriving just past 7am: a regular room to shower and nap in until the suite was ready. Free minibar, refilled daily.

8fd5a2d473c1863d.short: Confirmed a Sea View Suite, then got bumped further on arrival to one with a private infinity plunge pool. Would return in a heartbeat.

41f97e1a769d172d.short: Uncrowded even at a reported near 90 percent occupancy, and the kids club is his daughter's favorite anywhere. Pricey dining, but he'll keep going back.

e052cf8086489e67.short: Check-in was so quick that breakfast and the $30 founders fee never came up. What an Unbound Collection property should be.

bf94df899e62ee91.short: Welcome gift was a voucher for a glass of prosecco. Room not ready at 2pm, but loved the historic feel, service and food.

53ab783abdc6e3c9.short: Booked as a Guest of Honor by a Globalist friend. Breakfast charges were wiped even past the $42 per person allowance.

f2a24f7f4afc9f46.short: Absolutely incredible, once a call about a suite open in the app got them out of a hot, dated room with a dead cockroach.

5cd6030b032914b0.short: Binoculars and a plane-spotting guide in the suite, and a tub facing the airfield. One of the two best airport hotels in the world.

701a22ad80dd4269.short: Booked for a nap and shower on a long SFO layover with a toddler. The one to pick for an SFO overnight, cost permitting.

8395da8952c74c93.short: Arrived around 10am and chose to wait for a suite over a basic room right away. Enormous by New York standards.

bac6a921f333ae18.short: No suite because the hotel was busy. Breakfast in The Cellar was really good, but the Thompson Central Park won the head-to-head.

db1c3c74fc24b1b0.short: A family favorite for the design, location and food, though check-in meant a line with only two agents. Champagne and macarons on arrival.

729ac627d9e39d74.short: Soundproofing and blackout curtains held up despite Collins Avenue, but no real luggage rack. Breakfast at Aguasal was generous and handled dietary restrictions.

049b267728505e9f.short: No hot water in the first room or the second, and breakfast was a reheated sandwich. Won't return until the replacement hotel opens.

a36971789832cdee.short: Underwhelming buffet, so just a bagel and fruit. A tired property, though the price is fair and the Grand Central location can't be beat.

de9a7593f53ba0c0.short: The $40 destination fee was irritating and breakfast only acceptable. Would absolutely stay again for the room, views and value.

dd660f4b11fe5966.short: The standard bump to a deluxe Tokyo Tower view room rather than a suite, and a great upgrade all the same.

a512acf1e879c6f0.short: About a week here, after six or more earlier stays, with the usual upgrade. Breakfast had slipped a little since February, the only notable downside.

e1cb9629cf998aea.short: First visit since before COVID, and sublime. Standard rooms and bathrooms beat most suites elsewhere, and the minibar is still free.

d96d8737908ae6c6.short: Room ready on arrival around 7:30am, straight from Haneda. Breakfast was amazing, and 10 out of 10 for attention to detail.

64b03f0169bfee32.short: The January 1 earthquake and a canceled train meant a late arrival, handled after an email. The Sushi restaurant was excellent.

e9bc02646d1acb1f.short: Two connecting rooms for a family of four, and breakfast was honored for both adults and both kids.

2cc91033248d73bf.short: The hotel offered only two Twin rooms at first, then confirmed the suite a few days out. Comfy couch, but suites max out at three.

543fe7960921036b.short: The third adult's breakfast wasn't charged on a December 2022 Guest of Honor stay. Don't ask ahead, just accept it if billed.

3e567193b81bc78a.short: Dorayaki from housekeeping every couple of days, fast help by phone or app. Loved it, but may try The Edition on a future business trip.

d2b2f491ac376dc0.short: Loved the 610 sq ft suite despite an awful buffet and a mobile key that failed all stay. Likely a regular New York base.

536f5b8eba468807.short: Breakfast charges stuck until the Hyatt Concierge contacted the manager. Plans to return, and the suites' space and light make the award worth it.

58fdb574cf421ee1.short: Upgraded at check-in once the agent noticed the tall husband, and the hungry daughter got a cookie. The $30 nightly destination fee was one gripe.

c9459714e35b9f35.short: A roomy corner suite, but the view was mostly parking lot and the bathroom felt small. The outdoor pool is rare in San Francisco.

a6789222cc2ee261.short: A $24 breakfast cap often fell short of the promised entree, coffee and juice. Suite a bit dated, but still a go-to in Santa Barbara.

bce60adcab019ce8.short: The $30 resort fee, $20 daily parking and premium internet were all waived. A great, quiet beach getaway, with a room smaller than expected.

c3e6e55a8f201224.short: Instead of the roughly $75 extra, the Hyatt concierge got the balcony suite free. No hot water, ignored texts, no compensation: won't risk a return.

926f98b24d6de6b8.short: Bordeaux waiting and one of the best breakfasts since the pandemic. A lost suitcase never turned up during the stay, despite twice-daily checks.

45f3d3d8cfe16980.short: The hotel topped the upgrade award with a suite of almost 1,200 sq ft. Decor a bit dated for the brand was the only gripe.

0352ff6d83908b43.short: Just six standard suites, none offered, and a Diplomatic Suite quoted at 10,000 yuan. Fog hid the night views, yet a return is planned.

66fe4eab40e5ef9b.short: The free fourth night was refused at checkout until the front office manager who promised it stepped in. Still a phenomenal stay and a favorite.

27157e8dc7183f3c.short: Spacious even as a base room, and Beach Road Kitchen had the most extensive breakfast spread ever seen. Almost certain to return.

2311e1f36ae26929.short: For the points night the awards didn't cover, the check-in agent held a Deluxe Suite a few doors down. Best hotel ever, bar all-suite resorts.

247c5d849fa3264f.short: Free parking, no resort fee, and a big welcome package with a s'mores kit and $5 casino coupon. A 9 out of 10.

c980bfbedee47b23.short: Upgraded free to a $999-a-night cottage, put down to slow Covid business and an agent who liked them. One of the trip's best parts.

f2ee32c0e95e0587.short: Small, bland room, the least special of four Seattle Hyatts, though the food ranked first. Probably a skip next visit.

8668097fea9d1570.short: Traded housekeeping for a bottle of Washington Hills cabernet. Doorless shower, loud pipes, salty dinner: go mainly for the big gym and 84-degree pool.

ef5c80d3dac969bf.short: Got 4pm checkout, yet staff called at the usual time anyway. An hour's wait for a seat at the tiny pool, in a near-empty hotel.

0782c42e70f4605b.short: Terrace over the plaza, 4pm checkout offered at check-in, local olive oil as the gift. Polished service that lacked a warmer touch.

b4bfc100d3bdb33e.short: Suite showed in the app a couple of days ahead. Breakfast covered room service too, and the GM left a note and birthday cake.

2943ca857d8ba240.short: A corner junior suite with a narrow wraparound balcony over the Louvre. Possibly the best Hyatt in Paris, preferred over the Park Hyatt Paris-Vendome.

9eac71384d571fe3.short: Big first-floor suite with a separate living room and shabby furniture. Over a third of the rooms are suites, and breakfast came with champagne.

93a46d141017b73e.short: Hyatt honored the old 8,000-point rate after two pandemic delays. Superb soundproofing in the corner room, but the blackout curtains let in early sun.

c2d340ba62270e72.short: A suite for three, paid with points from one card welcome offer. Breakfast cost $0 including tip, and she would gladly return.

4c7b255a12655021.short: A curt check-in never mentioned the upgrade. Status waived the $50 daily resort fee, and the gift was a potted plant.

55d6becd49b1a06b.short: The full hot buffet was $8 extra: nickel-and-diming. Past its prime, more Grand Hyatt than Park Hyatt, but would return.

6b231a3e0ed2ce57.short: Booked the Terrace Suite outright, a suite no Globalist upgrade would reach. Common areas a little dated and cruise-ship-like, but clean and spacious.

71bfb6ff9f6e0eb4.short: No upgrade, a first in about 40 Hyatt stays, though King rooms looked open. Top-notch service, 4pm checkout, but 30k points a night felt steep.

8bc248e5b51efd95.short: No upgrade with only premium suites open, but staff remembered past visits. Good on a 32,000 JPY corporate rate, probably not at full price.

417e00d7b186376b.short: The hotel no longer sells upgrades, but the app showed one anyway the day before. Breakfast beat Park Hyatt Kyoto's.

56b267ab1a81c482.short: The first room smelled strongly of cigarette smoke, and staff took over 15 minutes to respond. The room felt basic and tired.

0b625e1c43aaed3c.short: Room not ready until 4pm, so dessert at the Pastry Shop while waiting. Massive bathtub and great views, but a quite firm mattress.

3f0d6cb583351175.short: Told no suites at check-in, then the Grand Club offered one around 5pm. Some service slips, but the renovated hotel is back.

1d4436409e9eebab.short: Extremely slow Wi-Fi, a room odor, and the chocolates and apples only after a follow-up. Would return only on a free night, otherwise the InterContinental.

248de5c9bf0613d0.short: The Eiffel view room wasn't ready, so a club twin first and a swap the next day. Evening club food was repetitive light bites.

41088e008aad84d9.short: Six people across two bookings, with the suite award turning one into two connecting rooms. Good value for families, but the club felt small.

35dbafed248b44e3.short: Breakfast was a $90 daily credit at Acacia House. The suite looks over greenery, not the Beringer vines, so next time a vineyard view room.

0c585cb5695a1f4a.short: The view from ground-floor room 311 didn't match the photos, and footsteps overhead kept waking them. Would return, asking for the third floor.

e69cd4d7f6da4e95.short: The Cabana Suite, selling at $418.62 a night, was roomy and clean in a dated hotel. Resort fee and parking waived, no pet fee charged.

d00349afca906ced.short: $117 AAA rate, their lowest ever for a paid New York stay. Small room, filthy window, but about 15 hours of sleep behind blackout curtains.

f2bded45d0b6d9e4.short: Got word in the app at mobile check-in: the hotel's only suite, selling for $774 that night, ready by 11am. Would definitely return.

1f1daf4d7dadcc2a.short: Third-party booking meant no breakfast or late checkout, so the desk gave a corner junior suite instead. A new Manhattan favorite despite street noise.

346fdfa1fdcfc7fb.short: 4pm checkout offered unasked, with 1,000 points as the welcome gift. Breakfast credit was $25 a person, yet the whole $33.75 bill came off.

caab9a32812a0075.short: Often upgraded to a suite here, but this time wanted the first room available to make the most of a stopover. Small but well designed.

115c6cfbeb41e4d7.short: Upgraded on all three stays, to a suite that's palatial by Manhattan standards. Upper Stories floors aren't eligible for elite upgrades.

9ac78b447105efab.short: No upgrade though a suite was on sale, put down to an inventory glitch. Dated, dirty hallways, and only the bare minimum for Globalists.

bbef7ecd03763b42.short: Breakfast ran past the $40 credit and still came off the bill both days. Less good: a mandatory 20% restaurant charge and aloof staff.

701b0650677a02a7.short: Room was late, and the desk refunded a few thousand points. Loved the rooftop pool and the food, and would book the same room again.

52488596f47b7063.short: Moved to a balcony room only after spotting one in the app. Asked for 4pm checkout, got 2pm after pushing back on 1pm.

cc048deea08e07fc.short: The $19 omelet at Harta was included, and the Bar Cima rooftop mezcal lounge was a high point. Top of their New York list.

0d8c5011783baf93.short: Four award nights with no cash charges at all, skipping the $30 nightly destination fee and taxes. The Empire State Building view was excellent.

4ae4ed6708c24265.short: The app showed a Family Lagoon Beach room, then the Presidential Suite, which sells for over $3,000 a night. 7pm checkout for a 2:30am flight.

326f1b3144b33225.short: Coffee refills never came at breakfast, and the hotel emailed an apology unprompted. A 9pm checkout cost 800 AED, about $220.

a0535ffaf786e477.short: Upgrade confirmed before arrival, no chasing needed. Breakfast had a serious Korean side, with abalone seaweed soup, mandu, kimchi and banchan.

6ca90a9fa6c264fc.short: The sunrise villa beat the sunset one a companion was upgraded to. Outstanding service, excellent snorkeling, food good not great.

5f270ff8510152d0.short: Put in the villa all four nights since no bungalow was free, though she'd have liked to try both. Champagne, chocolates and macarons were waiting.

a99cff77a047c253.short: Suites were available but no upgrade, until staff twice opened the door without knocking and the manager made amends with one.

9ae40a55cce3dbb9.short: 15,000 points a night against about 750 euros cash on Berlin marathon weekend. Among their favorite European hotels for location, space and service.

c21b1c40043d96dc.short: Resort fee waived, parking free, and evening club snacks could replace dinner some nights. Chaotic elevators and valet, but great value on points with status.

b745705c247e2fab.short: Asked for 4pm checkout and got 2pm. The room was already worn, but the pools rank among the best the kids have seen.

48057fb7aaa144aa.short: Booked a suite to fit five, then got bumped to the two-floor one. Breakfast was free for all five despite the two-adult, two-child rule.

83282995cec176bf.short: Room service breakfast came well over an hour late, and wrong. Amtrak horns past midnight mean the Seabird is probably the pick next time.

4fca5929d8ecca65.short: Breezeway Ocean View rooms have full ocean views but more train and street noise, with earplugs in the room. Late checkout stopped at 2pm.

5139fa9552a88896.short: Staff pointed to the $29 Japan Center garage over the $45 hotel lot. Great Japantown location, garden and service, and would love to stay again.

1ae25806cc9553e1.short: Breakfast was the weak spot: a heat-lamped egg and filler-heavy sausage on day one, better avocado toast on day two. Would stay again.

7680f212913c9668.short: Breakfast covered everything, even lattes to go, and award-stay parking was free, saving 21 euros a night. Roomy suite by European standards, huge bathroom.

cc1f1c7db66d5520.short: A better view came up first, then the suite. Street noise meant earplugs, but the short stay set a high bar for Thompson.

aafeef001b75b9eb.short: A $200 card credit cut the Amex night to $260.82. Two bookings meant checking out and back in, but it was a fantastic stay.

cd3c679482799f58.short: Dollar for dollar, their favorite Hyatt in Chicago. It felt safe, despite an Uber driver's warning that crime had reached the Gold Coast.

80fa427edb3bf223.short: A $152 family breakfast was fully waived. The lake barely shows past other buildings, and the nearest metro is about a 10-minute walk.

e9fa9a5674f319b9.short: Opening day, February 26, 2024. The opening gift was Hyatt House Shibuya slippers, three coffee packets, a Shibuya map and a notepad.

962e631472e978c4.short: Much like a Toyoko Inn. Category 4 pricing is justified by the location, not by the room or a breakfast short of Hyatt Place Kyoto's.

f07e8c912b6bfba0.short: Would not return despite the views, staff and breakfast: undrinkable instant coffee, a tiny shared gym, elevators jammed by the rooftop bar line.

b23974f2980298ea.short: A confused check-in missed the status at first, but the second-night water view made the stay. Would return only if sure of that view.

522dc6356be8b398.short: Suite was ready on arrival around 2pm, and the $100 Prive credit covered a $98 room-service dinner. Would definitely return.

c6979d33510f2c52.short: A text got the $30 destination fee off the bill within five minutes. Mixed: good rooftop bar, generic vibe, bare-minimum service unless prompted.

0b08b51c59b4922d.short: Suites were sold out, so a Premium room instead. The concierge left red wine for the birthday, and free breakfast could come by room service.

06c4eb05623ad2e2.short: The corner suite is 600 sq ft, up from 475. A suite upgrade award is worth using here, since standard rooms are fairly small.

40996c7987e5548e.short: Breakfast at Nine at the National was among their favorite Globalist breakfasts in the US. Would return in a heartbeat, the doorless, lukewarm shower aside.

4437ac1166d7e36c.short: Every perk was explained at check-in, and valet, normally $65 a night, was free on the award. Plans to return.

b6c2cfe39306f487.short: Resort fee waived, 8% service fee not. Slept poorly on an ultrasoft bed, yet would return with an eye mask and their own pillow.

f9ba4867685db0ef.short: Breakfast rules went unexplained: one entree and drink each, so a side of eggs for the kids was billed. Still loved the beachfront suite.

b455250b10375ebc.short: Massive villa, about $23,000 cash for five nights. Wonderful food, magical spa, but the W Maldives had better snorkeling and gets the return visit.

5057b0ac2217453c.short: Suite 520 was requested for its distance from the other villas. Seaplane transfers ran about $1,500 and a small load of laundry about $390.

12e5d2f3b5943406.short: The ground-floor room was dark and noisy from the valet stand. The junior suite meant better sleep, and its balcony sunsets justified the higher price.

2174ee8835e7c433.short: The king, about $20 a night more, tops 300 sq ft, big for London. Late checkout was 4pm, and minibar and happy hour were free.

17ecca4d14fe7700.short: Breakfast at 1901 ranks among their best hotel breakfasts in Europe. Check-in took about 20 minutes, and the $100 Prive credit posted as GBP 60.

7267bbd5d3adaf50.short: Preassigned the largest non-suite room, 275 sq ft, with the $30 facility fee waived. The TV behind a mirror and tiny bathroom counter were misses.

5be88dc2ef78d62f.short: The food kept causing indigestion, and the Work from Hyatt workspace was wrongly refused over the suite. Friendly service, though, and would consider a return.

b7d0e05f510eb0fb.short: Free parking on points saved $46 a day, with no pet fee for the dog. The open-plan suite works more like a junior suite.

3ee5d05e227da84d.short: A staycation on a friend's Guest of Honor award, with the $28 destination fee and $55 valet waived. The rooftop pool was still being built.

f08e8e07934335d3.short: Very spacious for Tokyo, with a washer-dryer and kitchen, and the Shibuya location is a big plus. Breakfast beat Hyatt Regency Tokyo's, not Yokohama's.

4ce01abc99166f8e.short: Did six days of laundry in the room, though the washer-dryer took over an hour to dry. Breakfast was not great, despite the view.

69c83d979991b0d1.short: Late checkout was 4pm, offered unasked. From the Narita Express platform at Shibuya, the New South exit leads stair-free to the hotel entrance.

39c19dcde29b3c06.short: Room not ready until after 3pm despite a 9am arrival and a resort that looked at least half empty. Gimmicky butler, no plans to return.

d909cbd9929cd61d.short: Felt exclusive mostly because it was nearly empty, and the room lacked the usual balcony tub. New points and cash prices rule out a return.

478fd48db772c090.short: Nice room and friendly staff, but Wi-Fi under 10 Mbps, a broken toilet seat and a room-service tray left in the hall about eight hours.

509b2ff3dd08ec17.short: The $60 breakfast cap was for everyone, not per person, and room service got breakfast wrong twice. Loved the hotel itself, but won't return.

a25b8854f0c79957.short: Kept the pool and racetrack views over a suite for night two. Several hot breakfast dishes were lukewarm, but he'd return in a heartbeat.

ec970343d2a33dec.short: Sophia's buffet was among the best he'd had. Only gripes: the MRT walk and no Dyson dryer or heated toilet seat in the base room.

6225455d8f383c1d.short: Corner suite looking over the Orchard district and the Botanic Gardens, and a caviar omelet on the breakfast menu. Pre-renovation decor felt dated, service excellent.

be3d53490780d054.short: Holiday nights at 35,000 points each, when cash topped $3,000 a night. Breakfast was a meager continental set, and umbrellas cost $25 a day.

e602c8f8ebfa6dcb.short: The $45-a-day amenity fee covered swan boats and spa areas that got used, and Epcot is a 10-minute walk. Now a favorite on Disney property.

e10e1aed524543c4.short: No upgrades to the renovated Hokupa'a Tower for top elites, and breakfast was a little fruit and coffee. Next time: the Ritz-Carlton or Hyatt Regency.

e7b0d8ab1c70a3b4.short: Continental breakfast was free, the full buffet $27 a person. A 9.5 out of 10 and top of the list for a yearly return.

c268749a13ec9209.short: Upgraded twice, to a better view before arrival and to the junior suite at check-in. Parking and resort fees added $371 to the points stay.

135281270b447156.short: Got 1,750 points instead of any breakfast choice, which felt stingy. Liked the vibe, pool and Hideout bar, and would still have booked it.

233783e85c0f69a0.short: Suite Night Awards cleared four days out into a suite selling for $750 or more a night. Evening canapes included oysters and prawns.

d7933ee0ad2891a4.short: Extra bed added for the kids. Across from Hyde Park, with a heated rooftop pool and a very well-stocked buffet at Feast.

32844864c97cb85e.short: The suite felt bland and a beach umbrella cost $60 on top of the $39 resort fee. Still worth it for the beachfront.

cb855866a9deeb22.short: Room asked for at 11 a.m. was ready at 2:22 p.m., and parking across the street was a hassle. Fantastic service, would return.

2f2edbc5413fef11.short: Upgraded at a check-in around 1 a.m., on a $90 CAD Prive rate. Breakfast favorites were the nasi lemak and the congee.

2211c46239d98a72.short: Possibly the best value in the Hyatt chain, with excellent entrees around $8 to $12. The small pool and gym can feel tight when full.
